title: Rockstar launches GTA 6 collector's edition for 400 euros without including the game
summary: The luxury physical edition includes collectible items but forces players to buy the game separately, drawing criticism from fans.

title: Control Resonant receives launch patch that fixes its main difficulty issue
summary: Remedy releases an immediate update that adjusts combat balance and eases the game's early stages.

title: Bungie transforms Marathon into a more ambitious game with social zones, deathmatch, and a new biome
summary: The extraction shooter evolves beyond its original formula with massive updates planned for December and March.

title: Call of Duty: Warzone adds a toggle to hide flashy skins and restore realism
summary: The 'cosmetic toggle' option allows players to disable the most flamboyant operator appearances in matches.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever introduces dynamic weather, secret druid forms, and meta-changing items
summary: The revamped classic version adds systems that alter gameplay and uncover unexpected rewards for veterans.

title: Nintendo cancels Zelda spin-off starring Ganondorf developed by Ubisoft
summary: The project, which had been in development for some time, was rejected and ultimately scrapped by the Japanese company.

title: Arc Raiders finally tests an exclusive PvE mode following community requests
summary: Embark Studios will conduct a week-long test to evaluate the viability of a mode without hostile players.

title: Discord attempts age verification again with a system that estimates age with 90% accuracy
summary: The platform implements changes following previous criticism, promising greater safety for teens without altering the adult experience.

title: Bethesda guarantees Obsidian's creative identity following its acquisition and project cancellations
summary: The studio behind Fallout: New Vegas will maintain its autonomy despite moving under Bethesda's direct oversight.

title: Meta unveils lightweight, expensive VR glasses that function as a media hub and for playing Xbox
summary: The new device, slated for 2027, prioritizes content consumption over traditional gaming and exceeds Apple's glasses in price.

title: Silent Hill: Townfall arrives with projector puzzles and a discounted edition, while fans debate its survival
summary: The new saga entry combines psychological horror with puzzle-solving mechanics in a portable setting.

title: Epic Games faces multi-million dollar lawsuits in the US and Europe over aggressive monetization practices targeting minors
summary: A class-action lawsuit in the United States and another from a Dutch consumer association seek compensation for deceptive tactics in Fortnite.

title: The Blood of Dawnwalker softens its controversial time mechanic after player fear of pressure
summary: Developers relaxed the original, much stricter timer to prevent anxiety from driving away the audience.

title: Xbox's drastic restructuring generates confusion and fear of mass layoffs in the community
summary: Internal changes and the absence of key figures at public events fuel uncertainty about the division's future.

title: Quake Champions abandons free-to-play model and becomes a paid game on Steam following layoffs at id Software
summary: The arena shooter removes its Microsoft Store version and now costs 9 pounds after eight years as free-to-play.

title: Castlevania returns to mobile for free and prepares a new series connecting animation with games
summary: The original classic is now available on iOS and Android, while Belmont's Curse will serve as a narrative bridge.

title: Over the Hill emerges as the spiritual successor to Forza Horizon as details of the sixth installment leak
summary: A new open-world driving game promises to fill the void left by the Playground Games saga.
